notes: TEMPLATE — not a real recipe. The sha256 above is a placeholder (64 zeros), which is not a value sha256sum ever actually produces, so this file cannot accidentally match a real installer. To make a real recipe: copy this file, run `winbridge recipe show path/to/the/installer.exe` to get the real sha256, replace the placeholder with it, set apply.tricks/dllOverrides/dxvk to what the app actually needs, rename the id to something specific to that app and version, and update this notes field to say what you tested.
